items.stem: A team wants to sustain a process improvement after the project closes. Select TWO actions that belong to the Control phase.

options.text: Create a control plan with response actions
options.rationale: Correct: a control plan is a core Control-phase deliverable.

options.text: Standardise the new method as documented standard work
options.rationale: Correct: standard work locks in the improved method.
Root-cause brainstorming belongs to the Analyse phase.
The charter is a Define-phase artefact.
Baseline data collection is a Measure-phase task.

items.explanation: A control plan and documented standard work are Control-phase actions.
